persos.pose: standing in the foreground on the left at the counter, holding out his phone

persos.desc: young man in his 20s, lime-and-charcoal t-shirt, thin mustache, holding ONE small screwdriver
persos.pose: sitting behind the wooden counter on the right, screwdriver in hand, relaxed

dialogue: Mon petit, efface tous les messages de mon téléphone-là, vite dêh !
Ya fohi, Tonton. Ta femme a déjà payé pour les récupérer.
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. The husband, in the foreground, holds out his phone and begs in a low urgent voice, his face three-quarters to the camera. The repairer, seated, smiles kindly, taps the counter with the screwdriver and answers, his face clearly visible.
chute: The husband's outstretched hand freezes, the phone trembling slightly. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the panicked husband's busted face looking into the camera.
gag_legende: LE RÉPARATEUR EN COMPTANT SES BILLETS :
mecanisme: le complice payé des deux côtés : double cible (le mari qui efface, la femme qui espionne)
